$comment: Components listed here get generated parameters, copied fixtures and parity checks. Add a component here, run `npm run sync`, then write its .razor markup.

overrides.$comment: Where an upstream template accepts more than its macro-options.json declares. Keyed by component/option/path.

additionalOptions.$comment: Options an upstream template reads but its macro-options.json does not declare.

character-count.name: charactersUnderLimitText
character-count.description: Message shown when under the character limit, by plural rule (for example `one`, `other`). `%{count}` is replaced with the number remaining.

character-count.name: charactersAtLimitText
character-count.description: Message shown when at the character limit.

character-count.name: charactersOverLimitText
character-count.description: Message shown when over the character limit, by plural rule. `%{count}` is replaced with the number over.

character-count.name: wordsUnderLimitText
character-count.description: Message shown when under the word limit, by plural rule.

character-count.name: wordsAtLimitText
character-count.description: Message shown when at the word limit.

character-count.name: wordsOverLimitText
character-count.description: Message shown when over the word limit, by plural rule.

password-input.name: prefix
password-input.description: Options for the prefix element, as for the input component.

password-input.name: suffix
password-input.description: Options for the suffix element, as for the input component.

search-input.name: placeholder
search-input.description: Placeholder text for the search input.

scroll.name: labelledBy
scroll.description: The id of the element that labels the scrollable region, for example a table caption.

tabs.name: classes
tabs.description: Classes to add to the tabs container.

tabs.name: attributes
tabs.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the tabs container.

pagination/items.name: classes
pagination/items.description: Classes to add to the list item.

code.name: caller
code.description: Code to show, as child content. Whitespace is kept.
